name: Twin Skeletons at The Sacrificial Festival
source:
Apparently, a life after death is possible. I've seen it with my own eyes.

Black gate. Moon. Sky. 

That's all I remember. I guess I made some friends, too. Why are skeletons so weird?

[From [url=https://stitchgirlechox.itch.io/twin-skeletons-at-the-sacrificial-festival]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
看来，死后的世界真的存在。我亲眼见到了。

黑色的大门。月亮。天空。

我记得的就只有这些了。我想我也交到了几个朋友。为什么骷髅都这么古怪呢？

[摘自[url=https://stitchgirlechox.itch.io/twin-skeletons-at-the-sacrificial-festival]itch.io[/url]]
